line.name: Onyx Vintage Nicaragua
line.description: Released September 2023 - a 100% Nicaraguan-puro release built around an extra-aged Habano Nicaragua wrapper from a 2019 harvest. Positioned as medium-to-full-bodied, deliberately less intense than Onyx Bold Nicaragua and with a lighter wrapper color, distinguishing it from the brand's traditional dark 'black/onyx' look while still carrying the Onyx name. Flavor notes: black pepper, leather, earth, dark chocolate, sweetness.
line.factory: Tabacalera A.J. Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A., Esteli, Nicaragua

research_notes: QA note: Bold Nicaragua and Vintage Nicaragua share identical vitola names and dimensions (Robusto 5x50, Toro 6x54, Magnum 6x60) despite being different blends - corroborated by two independent sources, so treated as verified rather than a data-entry duplication error, but flagged as an unusual coincidence worth double-checking.
